name: Signal
flavor: Semaphore post. Shows red while a train sits on the tile it guards.

name: Water Tower
flavor: Stations within two tiles load 25% faster and refill steam engines' water.

name: Coaling Stage
flavor: Bunker and chute. Trains at stations within two tiles refuel from your stockpile.

name: Power Line
flavor: Pole and wire. Links to poles and plants within two tiles; powers the rails around it.
